name: ZG Group
summary: ZG Group, founded in 2012 and based in Shanghai, runs an online platform linking third-party steel transactions in mainland China, the United Arab Emirates, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Korea and elsewhere. Its segments cover commission-based transaction services, logistics, warehousing and settlement support, technology subscriptions such as SaaS and data analysis, and overseas distribution, and it also procures non-steel products. Its customers include electronics, electrical, hardware and non-ferrous metals sectors.
